# Video Knowledge Studio

> Local video learning workspace and Agent-assisted animation production. Search
> Bilibili/YouTube with external tools, organize sources, render from a reviewed
> spec, and study timestamped notes with contextual AI questions.

- [README](README.md): installation, supported workflow, and current limits.
- [Chinese quick start](docs/quickstart-zh.md): local setup and first steps.
- [Agent MCP bridge](docs/agent-mcp.md): named tools and local connection details.
- [HTTP API](docs/api.md): application endpoints and workflow recovery.
- [Course pack format](docs/course-pack.md): required data and evidence structure.
- [Limitations](docs/limitations.md): features not implemented and operational limits.

Optional `search_sources` uses yt-dlp and may be rejected by the platform. Do not
claim one-click transcription, sourced spec generation, or verified
note creation: these require external tools or human work. The production workflow
begins with a reviewed spec and pauses between stages.
